description: This file defines the 'GrainTypeSharedContext' class, which encapsulates shared functionality and context data for all instances of a specific grain type within the Orleans distributed application framework. The class manages components, configurations, grain directory resolution, placement strategy, and lifecycle hooks for grain activations.

classes.name: GrainTypeSharedContext
classes.description: Provides shared state, configuration, and lifecycle management for all grain instances of a particular type within Orleans.

classes.name: IActivationLifecycleObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing creation and destruction events of grain activations.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a registered component or default instances like placement strategy or logger.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Registers a component instance for later retrieval.

methods.name: OnCreateActivation
methods.description: Hook invoked when a grain activation is created, used here to increment grain usage metrics.

methods.name: OnDestroyActivation
methods.description: Hook invoked when a grain activation is destroyed, used here to decrement grain usage metrics.
